name: reelpulse.posts.list
description: List posts and drafts with derived scheduled-to-published status from ctx.virtual_now.

name: reelpulse.posts.get
description: Read one post or draft including revisions, comments, asset_ids and authorized resource_uris.

name: reelpulse.posts.search
description: Search posts by status, audience, hashtag, caption/title query or date window.

name: reelpulse.comments.list
description: List comments on a post without mutating moderation state.

name: reelpulse.sponsors.list
description: List sponsorship briefs for the current creator account.

name: reelpulse.sponsors.get
description: Read a sponsorship brief by sponsor_id or post_id.

name: reelpulse.circles.get
description: Read audience circles and member sharing limits (including visible badge_label mappings).

name: reelpulse.analytics.summary
description: Summarize aggregate engagement metrics across published posts.

name: reelpulse.recommend.slots
description: Rank topic angles and posting slots using round2(avg_save_rate*0.55 + avg_completion_rate*0.35 - avg_negative_feedback_rate*0.60).

name: reelpulse.asset.read
description: Read integrity metadata and SHA-256 for an asset attached to a post (visual inspection uses MCP resources/read).

name: reelpulse.posts.create_draft
description: Create a new carousel or reel draft.

name: reelpulse.posts.update_draft
description: Update a draft post title, caption, paid_partnership disclosure or tags and append a revision.

name: reelpulse.posts.schedule
description: Schedule a post for a future timestamp after enforcing sponsorship disclosure, embargo and tag rules.

name: reelpulse.posts.publish
description: Publish a post immediately at ctx.virtual_now after enforcing sponsorship rules.

name: reelpulse.posts.set_visibility
description: Change the audience of a scheduled or published post, enforcing sponsorship rules on audience expansion.

name: reelpulse.posts.unpublish
description: Return a scheduled or published post back to draft state.

name: reelpulse.comments.hide
description: Hide a spam or abusive comment on a post (idempotent).

name: reelpulse.comments.reply
description: Post a creator reply to an existing comment on a published post.

name: reelpulse.comments.pin
description: Pin an existing visible comment on a published post; rejects with post_not_published or comment_not_found when unavailable.

name: reelpulse.circles.update_member
description: Update a circle member membership tier or sharing limit.
